posts.text:
We have to stand up to Trump’s unconstitutional and reckless war.

Video

Their hypocrisy knows no bounds.

Video

The costs of Trump's war are staggering.

Video

ICE is reckless and out of control. Not only are they violating people’s rights, they are hurting our economy and small businesses all over the country.

Video

Robert Mueller was a dedicated and honorable public servant. He served his country in the Marines, as a federal prosecutor, and led the FBI at a critical time in our nation’s history.

Throughout his life, he demonstrated a commitment to the rule of law above partisanship and the relentless pursuit of justice.

I am lifting up his family and loved ones as they remember his legacy.

A valuable perspective from a master of story.

Robert McKee is a master story teller and his mission is both simple and profound:
ease the suffering of others,
and add to their well-being.

In a hurting world,
that is a worthy calling. 

From the great @richroll podcast.

Video

Even those who have supported this President in every election have had enough of Trump’s wars and tariffs.

Video

Trump needs to stop worrying about plastering his face everywhere, and start caring working to lower the price of gas and groceries.

Video

Youth sports is now a $40 billion industry. It’s gotten out of control. 

As spring sports get underway, too many kids are sitting them out—not because they don't want to play, but because their families can't afford it. 

Youth sports should not be a luxury good.

Video

Big agriculture monopolies are taking advantage of farmers and driving up your food prices.

Video

The SAVE Act is going to prevent Americans from voting. We must ensure everyone’s voice can be heard.

Video

Help someone.
Encourage someone.
No matter what’s happening in the world, we can always choose to be a force for good and make a meaningful difference in someone’s life. 

Be the reason someone believes in the goodness in the world.

Video

We have to stand against Donald Trump’s bigotry and his hate fueled policies.

Video

Senator Padilla lays it plain.

Video

The SAVE Act is not about stopping voter fraud, it’s about preventing Americans from exercising their right to vote.

Video

Trump has spent both of his presidencies insulting and undermining our allies, but now he needs their help to compensate for his chaotic and idiotic blunders.

Video

Gun violence is the #1 killer of American children.

This incredible film shows the tragic impact on the grieving families who’ve experienced such immense loss. In awe of their enormous strength in sharing their stories.

Video

Trump’s high gas prices are going to raise the cost of living for all Americans.

Video

Our tax code is broken, but we can put working families first and give the majority of Americans more money in their pocket.
